notes:
**Links say more.** A link button now has two lines: the piece's title (much less of it cut off) and the page. A link into a hymnal says "Hymn 342". The second line also says when a link is two-way, and when it opens on one tablet only.

**Choose where a link opens.** With the Link tool selected, tap a link with the pen. Its menu now has "Open on slave" and "Open on device 3". Tick one and a tap on that link opens the piece on that tablet only. The setting syncs to every tablet. The boxes are grayed out when they don't apply, such as on a single tablet. If the chosen tablet isn't connected, the link opens on the pair as usual.

**Library count on the right.** The number of pieces in your library now sits at the right of the screen.
